answer: Require each agent to build non-transferable reputation through audited, useful work verified by independent peers: completing deliveries or answering queries, with each success signed by a different verifier. Trust decays over time and cannot be bought or copied, so a new identity starts at zero. Like a vine that must grow across a ridge into karst country, an attacker must pay the full time and computation cost for every fake identity, one by one, while honest agents keep their earned standing. Creating thousands of Sybils therefore costs far more work than it can ever earn.
